result:
The build is still running, so this session ends in the waiting state the role defines. Recap:

**Outcome:** PR #237 merges into master again. The conflict was the same one session 3 hit, in `docs/testing/nv2a_index.json`, this time caused by the vshconst fold (#234) also regenerating the index. I merged `origin/master` with no rebase, regenerated the index on the merged tree, and pushed merge head `938543d60d`.

**Checks on that head:**
- Both arm refs (`9c5f7416d8`, `9de95de849`) confirmed ancestors with `merge-base --is-ancestor`, so the PASS verdict stays bound.
- Index `check` passes with the same shape as master's: 104 suites, 2845 sites, one resolved table, tests commit `6743b6ab`.
- Preflight passes with `--allow-tracker`.
- PR is ready (not draft) and reports MERGEABLE. Body's Base and Files lines updated via REST and read back. Files now also lists the two audit files that sit on the branch.
- The arm verdict was already recorded on #91 in session 2.

**What I wrote down:** session 4 in `docs/lanes/clrwb91/NOTES.md` says why session 3 stopped (it finished, then master moved), and records the two-flag regeneration recipe. The `build` command refuses without `--tests`, and without `--support ~/pbkitplusplus` it silently writes zero resolved tables. A `[lane.clrwb91] waiting:` comment on the PR names the head and the resolving signal.

**Waiting on:** the `build` check on `938543d60d`. The `check` job is already green. When build goes green, the next step is the label swap:

```
bash docs/testing/jobs/gh-label.sh rm  237 needs-rebase
bash docs/testing/jobs/gh-label.sh add 237 fold-ready
```

I did not push a NOTES-only commit after the merge, to avoid a fresh head and a second CI run. One caveat for the fold: this PR will conflict on the index again if another fold regenerates it before this one lands.
